description_en: Queries the basic information about all Resource Access Management (RAM) users in the recycle bin
description_zh: 查询回收站中的所有RAM用户的基本信息
name: ListUsersInRecycleBin

parameters.help_en: The `marker`. If part of a previous response is truncated, you can use this parameter to obtain the truncated part
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，可以使用`Marker`获取从当前截断位置之后的内容。
parameters.name: marker

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return. If a response is truncated because it reaches the value of `MaxItems`, the value of `IsTruncated` will be true.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果的条数。当返回结果达到`MaxItems`限制被截断时，返回参数`IsTruncated`将等于true。 

取值范围：1~100。默认值：100
parameters.name: max_items

parameters.help_en:
The filter condition that is used to query information about a specified RAM user in the recycle bin.

You must specify this parameter in the `UserPrincipalName eq <username>@<AccountAlias>.onaliyun.com` format
parameters.help_zh:
过滤条件，查询回收站中指定RAM用户登录名的信息。

格式：`UserPrincipalName eq <username>@<AccountAlias>.onaliyun.com`
parameters.name: filter

IsTruncated.description_en:
Indicates whether the response is truncated. Valid values:

true

false
IsTruncated.description_zh:
请求返回结果是否被截断。取值：

true
false

Marker.description_en: The parameter that is used to obtain the truncated part. It takes effect only when `IsTruncated` is set to `true`
Marker.description_zh: 此参数在`IsTruncated`为`true`时生效，用于获取截断后的内容

User.description_en: The information about the RAM users

items.description_en: The information about the RAM user

CreateDate.description_en: The time when the RAM user was created
CreateDate.description_zh:
RAM用户的创建时间。

格式：RFC 3339（UTC），例如：2020-10-12T09:12:00Z

DeleteDate.description_en: The time when the RAM user will be permanently deleted from the recycle bin
DeleteDate.description_zh:
RAM用户将从在回收站中彻底删除的时间。

格式：RFC 3339（UTC），例如：2020-11-15T09:12:00Z

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the RAM user

RecycleDate.description_en: The time when the RAM user was deleted and moved to the recycle bin
RecycleDate.description_zh:
RAM用户被删除进入回收站的时间。

格式：RFC 3339（UTC），例如：2020-10-15T09:12:00Z

UserId.description_en: The ID of the RAM user

UserPrincipalName.description_en: The logon name of the RAM user
